items.q: What should you remember about **Director, not slot machine**?
items.a: **sandwich delegation between heavy planning** and verification; never "go rip" without a spec and success criteria.

items.q: What should you remember about **Verification lifts first-pass quality**?
items.a: **without checks ~65–70%; with** self-validation harnesses ~92% on first pass.

items.q: What should you remember about **Dumb zone ~250K tokens (Opus 4.8)**?
items.a: **compact or hand off** before quality drops; Sonnet 4.6 degrades earlier (~100–125K).

items.q: What should you remember about **Attention is scarce**?
items.a: **skills load on demand; avoid** front-loading MCP tool schemas; needle-in-haystack problem worsens in dumb zone.

items.q: What should you remember about **Harness = LLM + tools + context wrapper**?
items.a: **Claude Code is the base** harness; your AI layer (CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks, MCP/CLI) sits on top.

items.q: What should you remember about **CLI + skill beats MCP for token efficiency**?
items.a: **Cole's pattern for CRM,** GitHub, and his Arkon orchestrator.

items.q: What should you remember about **Sub-agents for research, not orchestration**?
items.a: **poor handoffs between sub-agents;** prefer deterministic multi-session workflows (Ralph loop, Arkon).

items.q: What should you remember about **Custom planning skill over plan mode**?
items.a: **Cole prefers his own** planning skill for question flow and section control.

items.q: What should you remember about **Hooks for security and memory**?
items.a: **pre-tool checks block dangerous commands;** session-end hooks write daily logs and promote to memory.md ("Claude dreaming").

items.q: What should you remember about **Every bug → permanent upgrade**?
items.a: **update CLAUDE.md, skills, or planning** docs so failures don't repeat; almost welcome bugs as training data.

items.q: What should you remember about **Assume the agent will do everything it can access**?
items.a: **Nate's team accidentally emailed entire** list with wrong discount code; prompts cannot substitute scoped permissions.

items.q: What should you remember about **Intent engineering**?
items.a: **give Claude the *why*** during planning; shapes the how (Anthropic 4.8 docs align).
